title: Octopus reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Book -->
  <rect x="25" y="60" width="50" height="30" rx="3" fill="#e8c84a"/>
  <rect x="25" y="60" width="25" height="30" rx="3" fill="#f0d860"/>
  <rect x="50" y="60" width="25" height="30" rx="3" fill="#d4b43c"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="62" x2="50" y2="88" stroke="#c4a030" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Pages -->
  <rect x="27" y="62" width="21" height="26" rx="2" fill="#fff8e0"/>
  <rect x="52" y="62" width="21" height="26" rx="2" fill="#fff0c8"/>
  <!-- Page lines -->
  <line x1="30" y1="68" x2="45" y2="68" stroke="#d8c8a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="73" x2="45" y2="73" stroke="#d8c8a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="78" x2="43" y2="78" stroke="#d8c8a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="68" x2="70" y2="68" stroke="#d8c8a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="73" x2="70" y2="73" stroke="#d8c8a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Octopus head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="22" ry="20" fill="#e0558a"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="36" rx="20" ry="17" fill="#f06898"/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="36" r="5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="36" r="5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="37" r="2.5" fill="#3a1a2a"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="37" r="2.5" fill="#3a1a2a"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="36" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="36" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- Cute blush/mouth -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="46" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#c44070"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="43" r="3" fill="#f888b0" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="43" r="3" fill="#f888b0" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Tentacles -->
  <!-- Left tentacles reaching to book -->
  <path d="M32 50 Q20 55 24 65 Q26 70 30 68" fill="none" stroke="#e0558a" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M28 52 Q14 58 18 70 Q20 76 26 72" fill="none" stroke="#d04878" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M35 54 Q25 62 28 74 Q30 80 36 76" fill="none" stroke="#f06898" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Right tentacles -->
  <path d="M68 50 Q80 55 76 65 Q74 70 70 68" fill="none" stroke="#e0558a" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M72 52 Q86 58 82 70 Q80 76 74 72" fill="none" stroke="#d04878" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M65 54 Q75 62 72 74 Q70 80 64 76" fill="none" stroke="#f06898" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Tentacle suckers (small dots) -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="60" r="1.5" fill="#f888b0"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="66" r="1.5" fill="#f888b0"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="60" r="1.5" fill="#f888b0"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="66" r="1.5" fill="#f888b0"/>

  <!-- Bottom middle tentacles -->
  <path d="M42 52 Q36 62 40 72" fill="none" stroke="#e86898" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M58 52 Q64 62 60 72" fill="none" stroke="#e86898" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Book highlight -->
  <rect x="27" y="62" width="21" height="3" rx="1" fill="#fffef5" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <circle cx="15" cy="30" r="1.5" fill="#ffe680"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="25" r="1.5" fill="#ffe680"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="50" r="1" fill="#ffe680"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="48" r="1" fill="#ffe680"/>
</svg>
